new_quizzes_unattached_bank_migrations.summary: Migrates all question banks into 'New Quizzes' during course import/copy. New Quizzes is an Instructure-hosted service unavailable self-hosted, so this must stay off to avoid breaking question banks.

new_sis_integrations.summary: Shows extra settings for syncing assignment grades to an external student records system (SIS). Page Schools has no student records system connected to Canvas, so the new settings would have nothing to sync to.

new_user_tutorial.summary: Shows built-in tutorial panels to teachers who are new to Canvas, explaining what each course page (assignments, grades, modules, etc.) is for. A low-effort way to help staff get comfortable during onboarding.

new_user_tutorial_on_off.summary: Shows step-by-step tips on each course page to help teachers who are new to Canvas set up their courses. Useful for onboarding staff who have never used the platform.

newquizzes_on_quiz_page.summary: Shows quizzes built with Instructure's 'New Quizzes' engine on the regular Quizzes page. New Quizzes is a separate Instructure-hosted service that a self-hosted school instance does not have, so this does nothing here; the built-in Classic Quizzes are unaffected.

non_scoring_rubrics.summary: Lets teachers create rubrics (marking guides) that give written feedback without attaching point values. Useful for formative feedback on younger pupils' work where you want comments, not marks.

notification_service.summary: Routes email/notification sending through Instructure's remote dispatch queue instead of the local job system. On a self-hosted instance you send notifications yourself, so this is vendor plumbing that should stay off.

oak_for_admins.summary: Enables 'IgniteAI', Instructure's AI assistant for admins, which is powered by Instructure-hosted AI backends. Does nothing on a self-hosted school instance.

oak_for_teachers.summary: Enables 'IgniteAI Agent', Instructure's hosted AI assistant for teachers and admins. It depends on Instructure's AI backend, so it does nothing on a self-hosted school instance.

oak_for_users.summary: Shows a floating IgniteAI assistant button for teachers and admins, an AI helper chatbot backed by Instructure's cloud AI. Without Instructure's hosted AI services, the button is dead weight on a self-hosted instance and should stay off.

observer_appointment_groups.summary: Lets teachers allow parents/guardians (observer accounts) to book appointment slots in the Canvas calendar, for example for parent-teacher conference sign-ups. Genuinely handy for a K-12 school where parents have observer accounts.

open_todos_in_new_tab.summary: A personal preference that makes items on a teacher's to-do list open in a new browser tab instead of the same one. Harmless quality-of-life tweak, per user.

open_tools_in_new_tab.summary: Makes external tool integrations open in a new browser tab, full-screen without the Canvas menus, instead of embedded in the page. Could help if an installed tool displays poorly inside a frame, but it is still hidden vendor work-in-progress.

originality_reports_for_a2.summary: Makes plagiarism-check reports show up in the newer assignment view. Page Schools has no plagiarism-checking service (like Turnitin) connected, so there is nothing for this to display.

outcome_alignment_non_scoring_content.summary: Lets teachers link learning outcomes to non-graded content such as pages, not just assignments and quizzes. Only meaningful if the school tracks curriculum mastery through Canvas's learning outcomes tools.

outcome_alignment_summary_with_new_quizz.summary: Includes quizzes from the 'New Quizzes' engine in the course summary of which activities cover which learning outcomes. New Quizzes is an Instructure-hosted service, so there is nothing to include on a self-hosted school instance.

outcome_alignments_course_migration.summary: Includes learning-outcome links handled by Instructure's hosted Outcomes Service when copying courses. Self-hosted instances use the built-in outcomes system rather than that hosted service, so this does nothing here.

outcome_average_calculation.summary: Adds 'average of all scores' as a way to calculate a student's level on a learning objective, alongside the existing methods (like highest score or most recent). Useful if the school tracks learning objectives and prefers averaging.

outcome_extra_credit.summary: When grading with a rubric that is tied to learning outcomes, this lets a teacher award more than the normal maximum points on an outcome, effectively allowing extra credit. Only matters if the school uses rubrics linked to learning outcomes.

outcome_gradebook.summary: Gives teachers a gradebook-style view of how each student is progressing against the course's learning objectives (mastered / near mastery / needs help), separate from ordinary scores. Useful if the school tracks skills or curriculum objectives, not just marks.

outcome_service_results_to_canvas.summary: Pulls learning-outcome results stored in Instructure's separate hosted Outcomes Service (used by New Quizzes in the cloud) back into Canvas's mastery gradebooks and reports. It exists to bridge a cloud service, so it has nothing to bridge on a self-hosted instance.

outcomes_friendly_description.summary: Lets staff add a parent- and pupil-friendly plain-language description to each learning outcome, shown in the student mastery view instead of formal curriculum wording. Nice touch if the school grades against outcomes and shares mastery views with families.

outcomes_new_decaying_average_calculatio.summary: Adds an updated 'decaying average' formula for scoring learning outcomes, which weights a student's most recent attempts more heavily than older ones. Only relevant if you grade against learning outcomes and care which averaging formula is used.

outcomes_rollup_propagation.summary: Controls a background process that pre-computes outcome score summaries into a database table for faster reporting. Site-admin-only performance plumbing.

outcomes_rollup_read.summary: Makes the Learning Mastery Gradebook read pre-computed summary tables instead of recalculating on the fly — a performance optimisation with no visible change.

password_complexity.summary: Gives administrators finer control over password rules — minimum length, banned common passwords, and similar requirements — for accounts that log in with a Canvas password. A sensible security upgrade for a school managing its own logins.

peer_review_allocation_and_grading.summary: An in-progress overhaul of peer review (students marking each other's work) that adds automatic reviewer assignment and separate due dates and grades for the reviews. Could interest teachers eventually, but it is still hidden vendor work-in-progress rather than a finished feature.

pendo_extended.summary: Sends extra usage-analytics metadata to Pendo, a third-party product-analytics service Instructure uses to study how people use Canvas. Vendor telemetry; does nothing useful for the school and is better left off.

people_page_modernization.summary: A redesign of the course People page (the class roster). Vendor interface modernization still in development; no functional change for the school to act on.

performance_improvements_for_gradebook.summary: Behind-the-scenes speed-up for loading the gradebook; vendor plumbing with no visible feature change.

permanent_page_links.summary: Makes links to a course page keep working even after the page's title is changed. Prevents broken links inside courses — a quiet but genuinely useful fix for teachers who rename pages.

persist_inferred_authentication_provider.summary: Remembers which login method each account used and ties new accounts to the default one. Only meaningful when a school runs multiple sign-in systems (e.g. Google plus Microsoft plus passwords); with a single login method it changes nothing noticeable.

pkce.summary: A security hardening step (PKCE) for the login handshake that third-party apps use when connecting to Canvas with a user's permission. Invisible to teachers and students, but a sensible security improvement for any instance that allows app integrations.

platform_service_speedgrader.summary: Replaces the marking screen (SpeedGrader) with a rebuilt version aimed at faster loading in very large courses. Parts of the rebuilt version rely on Instructure's hosted infrastructure, and a small school's classes are unlikely to hit the performance problems it targets.

platform_ui_unified_widgets_dashboard.summary: Swaps the Canvas dashboard for a new widget-based one imported from Instructure's shared platform interface project. In-development vendor rework; not something to enable on a production school instance.

post_grades.summary: Lets teachers push grades from Canvas back into an external student records system such as PowerSchool. Page Schools has no student records system connected to Canvas, so there is nothing to send grades to.

post_grades_enhanced_modal.summary: A rebuilt, more accessible version of the dialog used to sync grades out to a student records system. Since Page Schools has no external records system connected, the dialog it improves is not used.

pre_date_shift_for_assignment_importing.summary: A technical change to when due dates get adjusted during course copies — dates are shifted while items are created rather than fixed up afterwards. Same end result for teachers; it is an internal reliability/performance tweak to the import process.

precise_link_replacements.summary: A technical refinement to how links are rewritten when course content is imported or copied, touching only specific elements instead of all text. Internal migration plumbing.

prevent_deletion_outcomes_with_os_alignm.summary: Developer-only safety switch preventing deletion of learning objectives that are linked inside Instructure's separate hosted outcomes/New Quizzes service. Explicitly marked as not for adjustment; does nothing meaningful on a self-hosted instance.

product_tours.summary: Shows built-in guided walkthroughs that point new admins, teachers, and students around the Canvas interface. The tour content is written for Instructure's standard cloud product and may reference things a customized self-hosted instance does not have, but it can help first-time users find their way.

project_lhotse.summary: AI-assisted grading suggestions inside the modernized SpeedGrader, powered by Instructure's IgniteAI cloud service. Does nothing on a self-hosted school instance.

proxy_file_uploads.summary: Lets a teacher upload and submit a file on a student's behalf for file-upload assignments — useful when a pupil did the work on paper or a shared computer and the teacher digitises it. Very practical in a primary school where young children may not manage uploads themselves.

quiz_log_auditing.summary: Records a detailed activity log while a student takes a quiz (when they answered each question, if they left the quiz page, etc.) and lets teachers review that log afterwards. Useful for investigating suspected cheating or disputed quiz sessions, at the cost of some extra database storage.

quizzes_next.summary: Turns on 'New Quizzes', Instructure's replacement quiz engine with more question types. It runs as a separately hosted service connected via external tool integration — it is not part of the core self-hosted Canvas code, so on Page Schools' own server it will not work unless that separate service is also deployed (it normally is not available to self-hosters). Stick with classic quizzes.

quizzes_next_submission_history.summary: Changes how attempt history is stored for 'New Quizzes', Instructure's hosted next-generation quiz engine. New Quizzes is not available on a self-hosted instance, so this has no effect for Page Schools.

rce_a11y_resize.summary: Makes the rich text editor (the box teachers type page content into) resizable in a way that works with keyboards and screen readers. An accessibility improvement, though currently hidden vendor rollout plumbing.

rce_asr_captioning_improvements.summary: Improves automatic speech-recognition captions for media embedded through the rich text editor. Automatic captioning relies on Instructure's hosted media services, so it does nothing on a self-hosted school instance.

rce_find_replace.summary: Adds a find-and-replace tool inside the rich text editor teachers use to write pages, assignments, and announcements. Small but genuinely handy when updating dates or names across a long page.

rce_lite_enabled_speedgrader_comments.summary: Lets teachers use basic text formatting (bold, lists, links) when writing feedback comments in SpeedGrader, Canvas's grading screen, instead of plain text only. Small improvement to the quality of written feedback.

rce_studio_embed_improvements.summary: Improves how media from Canvas Studio (Instructure's separate paid video platform) is embedded via the rich text editor. Page Schools does not have Studio, so this does nothing.

rce_transform_loaded_content.summary: A behind-the-scenes cleanup step the rich text editor performs when loading content, mainly needed for New Quizzes compatibility. No visible feature; internal plumbing.

react_discussions_post.summary: The redesigned Discussions and Announcements interface — a cleaner, more modern layout for class discussions, with ongoing improvements. It is already on by default in current Canvas; teachers and students get a nicer discussion experience.

react_inbox_labels.summary: Lets users create labels for messages in the Canvas Inbox and filter conversations by label, similar to email labels. A modest organisational nicety for staff who get lots of Canvas messages.

react_people_page.summary: A behind-the-scenes rebuild of the course People page on newer technology, with no intended change to what it does. Vendor plumbing still in progress.

refactor_custom_variables.summary: An internal code restructuring of how placeholder variables for external tool integrations are computed in background jobs. Pure vendor plumbing.

render_both_to_do_lists.summary: For staff who are enrolled as both teacher and student somewhere, shows both their teacher to-do list and their student to-do list on the dashboard. A niche display tweak.

require_migration_to_new_quizzes.summary: Forces all imported quizzes to be converted to the New Quizzes format, removing the choice to keep them as classic quizzes. New Quizzes relies on an Instructure-hosted service that a self-hosted fork typically lacks, so forcing this would break quiz imports; keep off.

reset_uuid_on_course_reset.summary: A behind-the-scenes change to how a course's internal identity code is handled when the course is reset, mainly to make restores work better with the Instructure-hosted New Quizzes service. No visible change for users.

responsive_student_grades_page.summary: Makes the page where students view their own grades resize properly on phones and small screens. Worth turning on if students or parents check grades from mobile phones, which is common.

restore_discussion_entry.summary: Lets a teacher (or the original author) restore a deleted post in a class discussion instead of it being gone for good. Handy for undoing accidental deletions, though the flag is still hidden/in development.

restrict_quantitative_data.summary: Hides all numeric scores and points from students and parents, showing only letter grades or ratings. Aimed at schools with a qualitative grading philosophy; Page Schools uses numeric CA/exam scores, so probably not wanted, but it is a real pedagogical option.

restrict_student_access.summary: Adds account controls to limit what students can do with the messaging inbox, file management, and calendar events. Potentially attractive for a K-12 school wanting to lock down pupil-to-pupil messaging, but this is a hidden vendor-controlled flag that may be incomplete; the similar 'Allow Limited Access for Students' setting covers related ground.

rubric_assessment_imports_exports.summary: Lets teachers download and upload completed rubric marking as spreadsheet (CSV) files from the Gradebook, so marking can be done offline in bulk. Requires the Enhanced Rubrics feature to be on.

rubric_criterion_range.summary: Lets teachers define each rubric rating as a point range (for example 7-10 points) instead of a single fixed value, so they can fine-tune scores within a rating band. A small but genuinely helpful grading improvement.

rubric_self_assessment.summary: Lets teachers turn on self-assessment for an assignment, so students score their own work against the marking rubric before the teacher grades it. A genuinely useful teaching technique for building self-reflection skills.

safe_files_jti.summary: Adds a one-time-use token to file download links so an intercepted link cannot be replayed by someone else. Invisible security hardening for file downloads; already on by default.

scheduled_feedback_releases.summary: Lets teachers pick a future date and time when marks and comments for an assignment will be released to students automatically, rather than posting them by hand. Nice for coordinating release across classes, e.g. after all sections finish an exam.

scheduled_page_publication.summary: Lets teachers set a future date and time for a course page to go live automatically, instead of having to remember to publish it manually. Handy for releasing weekly lesson materials on a schedule.

selective_content_tag_export.summary: When a teacher shares individual items from a module with another teacher, only those items are packaged up instead of the whole module. A small correctness fix to content sharing between teachers.

self_service_user_merge.summary: Lets a person who accidentally ended up with two Canvas accounts combine them on their own, provided they can log in to both. Saves admins from doing merges manually, but also lets users do it without admin oversight.

self_signup_deadline.summary: Still in development: would let teachers set a cut-off date by which students must sign themselves up for a group (for group projects). Potentially handy for upper classes, but not finished yet, so leave it alone for now.

send_usage_metrics.summary: Vendor telemetry switch that sends usage statistics back to Instructure's servers; irrelevant and best left off on a self-hosted school instance.

show_recent_messages_on_new_roster_user_.summary: On the redesigned student/user detail page, shows that person's recent discussion messages, provided profiles are enabled in account settings. A minor convenience for teachers and admins looking up a student.

single_new_quiz_session_in_speedgrader.summary: A technical tweak to how the 'New Quizzes' engine loads inside the grading screen. New Quizzes is an Instructure-hosted service that self-hosted instances do not have, so this does nothing here.

skip_blueprint_module_downstream_changes.summary: A technical tweak to how 'blueprint' template courses sync deletions to their linked courses, avoiding spurious 'changed' markers. Only relevant if the school uses blueprint template courses, and even then it is an internal behavior fix.

skip_reactivating_deleted_attachments.summary: When course content is imported (for example copying a course), files the teacher had previously deleted stay deleted instead of quietly coming back. A sensible behaviour fix that prevents confusing 'ghost files' after course copies.

slack_notifications.summary: Would let users receive Canvas notifications in Slack, a workplace chat app. Requires a Slack integration the school does not use, and it is aimed at workplaces rather than K-12 classrooms.

smart_alerts.summary: Sends students timely automatic reminders about assignments that need their attention, such as upcoming due dates. Could help students stay on top of work, assuming notification email is configured on the server.

smart_search.summary: AI-powered 'smart search' across course content, branded IgniteAI. It requires AI embedding services (Instructure's hosted AI backends) to index content, so on a self-hosted instance without those configured it will not return results.

speedgrader_grade_by_student.summary: In the grading screen, lets a teacher stay on one student and move through all of that student's assignments, instead of grading one assignment across all students. A nice workflow option for teachers who mark student-by-student, though it is still in testing.

speedgrader_studio_media_capture.summary: Lets graders record their screen as video feedback inside the marking tool, using Canvas Studio — a separately licensed, Instructure-hosted video product. Without a Studio subscription it does nothing.

student_access_token_management.summary: Forces student-created API access tokens (keys that let apps act as the student) to expire within 120 days and lets admins delete them. A sensible security tightening with no downside for normal classroom use.

student_grade_summary_upgrade.summary: A behind-the-scenes rebuild of the student 'Grades' page on newer technology. Looks and behaves essentially the same for students; it exists to make the code easier for Instructure to maintain.

student_outcome_gradebook.summary: Gives students a gradebook-style page showing their progress on course learning outcomes (skills/standards), marked as mastered, near mastery, or needing work. Only meaningful if teachers actually set up learning outcomes; if you use outcomes, it is a nice self-monitoring tool for older pupils.

submission_comment_emojis.summary: Adds an emoji picker so teachers and students can put emojis in the comments they exchange on submitted work. A small, fun classroom nicety; some schools prefer to leave it off to keep feedback formal.

submission_comment_media_auto_captioning.summary: Automatically generates subtitles for audio/video feedback comments teachers leave on submissions. Captioning relies on Instructure's hosted media/AI captioning services, so on a self-hosted instance without those services configured it will not produce captions.

submission_stickers.summary: Lets teachers attach fun reward stickers to student submissions when marking — a good fit for primary-school encouragement. Requires the 'Assignment Enhancements - Student' feature to also be turned on.

syllabus_versioning.summary: Keeps a full history of every edit to a course's syllabus page, so teachers or admins can see what changed and restore an earlier version. Useful insurance against accidental deletions of the course outline.

temporary_enrollments.summary: Lets admins add someone to a course for a limited period, after which they are automatically removed — for example a substitute teacher covering a class for two weeks. Saves remembering to remove them manually.

timer_without_autosubmission.summary: Adds a setting on timed quizzes (the built-in classic quiz tool) so that when time runs out, the quiz is NOT automatically submitted — the student's attempt just stops accepting answers. Useful if teachers want to review timed-out attempts manually rather than have Canvas auto-submit them.

title_iv_financial_aid_report.summary: A compliance report for United States federal student financial aid (Title IV), part of the hosted 'Intelligent Insights' product. Irrelevant to a Nigerian K-12 school and non-functional self-hosted anyway.

top_navigation_placement.summary: Lets external tool integrations add a button to Canvas's top navigation bar. Only relevant if the school installs third-party tools that use this placement; with none installed it does nothing.

translate_inbox_messages.summary: Adds automatic translation of Canvas inbox messages into each user's preferred language, powered by IgniteAI, Instructure's hosted AI service. Does nothing on a self-hosted school instance.

translation.summary: Adds AI-powered translation of discussion posts and announcements into other languages, powered by Instructure's hosted IgniteAI service; does nothing on a self-hosted school instance.

tune_lti_context_id_history_query.summary: A database performance workaround for very large institutions with huge course-copy histories, affecting a technical lookup used by external tools. Irrelevant to a single small school; leave alone.

underline_all_links.summary: A per-user accessibility preference that underlines links in Canvas menus, the dashboard, and sidebars so they are easier to spot, which helps colorblind or low-vision users. Content links inside pages are always underlined regardless.

use_body_word_count.summary: A behind-the-scenes change to how the word count of typed submissions is calculated (stored once instead of recalculated every time), making pages load faster. No visible change for teachers or students.

use_comment_library_v2.summary: Switches SpeedGrader to a redesigned version of the comment library (the tool where teachers save reusable feedback phrases). Same feature, newer interface; low risk to enable if the comment library is in use.

use_dyslexic_font.summary: Lets an individual user swap the entire Canvas font for OpenDyslexic, a typeface designed to be easier to read for people with dyslexia. A free, self-contained accessibility win worth leaving available to users.

use_jwt_auth_for_utid_sync.summary: Changes how Canvas authenticates with LearnPlatform, an Instructure-hosted tool-catalog service, when syncing tool identifiers. Does nothing on a self-hosted school instance.

use_queue_for_rate_limiting_gradebook_re.summary: A technical throttling mechanism for how the gradebook fetches its data, to avoid overloading the server. No visible change for users.

use_semi_colon_field_separators_in_grade.summary: Makes downloaded grade spreadsheets use semicolons instead of commas between columns, which Excel expects in some countries' regional settings. Only needed if grade exports open as one jumbled column in Excel.

user_immersive_reader_wiki_pages.summary: Adds a button that opens Canvas pages in Microsoft's Immersive Reader, a free Microsoft web service that reads text aloud and simplifies the layout for struggling readers. It calls out to Microsoft's servers (not Instructure's), so it works from a self-hosted Canvas as long as students have internet access.

ux_list_concluded_courses_in_bp.summary: A tiny interface tweak that labels finished courses with a 'Concluded' tag in the blueprint-course association dialog. Shadow vendor plumbing; only visible if you use blueprint courses.

validate_call_to_action.summary: A small interface change: instead of greying out a submit button until a form is complete, the button stays clickable and shows an error message pointing to what is missing. Minor usability polish, no real admin decision needed.

verify_ldap_certs.summary: Makes Canvas verify the security certificate of an LDAP directory server (a staff/student login directory) before trusting it — a genuine security hardening. Only relevant if Page Schools ever hooks Canvas to an LDAP directory; with local Canvas logins it does nothing.

view_ungraded_as_zero.summary: Adds a Gradebook view where a teacher can see what class totals would look like if every unmarked submission counted as zero. It is display-only and never changes real grades — helpful for spotting pupils whose averages will drop once missing work is marked.

visibility_performance_improvements.summary: Speeds up the database queries that work out which students can see which assignments when teachers assign work to specific pupils or sections. Invisible performance plumbing.

widget_dashboard.summary: Lets students add, remove, and rearrange widgets on their Canvas dashboard for a more personalised home page. Still hidden/in-development, but a plausible nice-to-have for pupils once stable.

widget_dashboard_customization.summary: Adds extra customisation options to a newer widget-based dashboard layout. Harmless cosmetic option; only meaningful if the underlying widget dashboard is in use on your version.

wiki_page_mastery_path_no_assignment_gro.summary: An internal bug fix about how hidden placeholder assignments are created when pages are assigned through MasteryPaths (Canvas's conditional-release feature). Not a feature decision for the school.

youtube_migration.summary: Scans courses for embedded YouTube videos and offers to convert them into Canvas Studio, Instructure's paid hosted video platform. Page Schools has no Studio subscription and deliberately keeps YouTube embeds, so this must stay off.

youtube_migration_high_priority.summary: Makes background jobs that convert embedded YouTube content run at higher priority so they finish sooner. Server tuning plumbing; no user-facing feature.

youtube_overlay.summary: Puts an overlay on YouTube videos embedded in course content (a click-to-play cover instead of loading YouTube immediately). Relevant to Page Schools since seeded courses embed YouTube videos; mainly affects how and when the YouTube player loads for pupils.
